slides.texte_overlay:
5 words that will
expand your vocabulary

Ubiquitous:
found everywhere
(yoo-BIK-wi-tuhs)

Example:
Coffee shops are ubiquitous
in this city.

Tenacity:
the quality of never
giving up
(tuh-NAS-i-tee)

Example:
Her tenacity got her
through every exam.

Zealous:
full of energy and
enthusiasm for a cause
(ZEL-uhs)

Example:
She was a zealous
defender of libraries.

Benevolent:
kind and generous
(buh-NEV-uh-luhnt)

Example:
The benevolent teacher
stayed late for everyone.

Intrepid:
fearless and adventurous
(in-TREP-id)

Example:
An intrepid traveller,
she learned the history of
every city before visiting.
